# /stack-quality-gate

Use before merge, release, or handover.

1. Run `python scripts/doctor.py --quality-gate`.
2. Run stack-native tests and linters.
3. Run `python scripts/check-secrets.py`.
4. Run `python scripts/check-dependencies.py`.
5. Run `python scripts/check-coverage.py`.
6. Attach results to the change review and release checklist.

Do not bypass a failed gate without explicit PM/TA/QA Lead approval.
